What's my course level?
Undergraduate
Usually a Bachelor degree, this is a three or four-year course you’ll take following on from school-level education. It’s also known as a first degree.
Postgraduate taught
Usually a Masters degree, a postgraduate taught degree is the next step following on from an undergraduate degree. There are various levels of postgraduate taught study and they're usually undertaken between one year and three years, depending on whether you study full-time or part-time.
Postgraduate research
A postgraduate research degree is usually a PhD and is the highest level of degree a student can achieve. We also offer a range of other research degrees including Masters of Research, Masters of Philosophy, Engineering Doctoral degrees and Industrial Doctorates. This is also a route into academia as a career.
